operationalAccessPrerequisites.label: Live closeout Supabase project/functions access
operationalAccessPrerequisites.ownerAction: Use a Supabase account that can manage the target project and access the functions API, then rerun the strict live closeout readiness verifier before claiming O*NET ingest or parse-resume deployment completion.
operationalAccessPrerequisites.acceptedWhen: The strict live closeout readiness verifier exits 0 without --allow-incomplete, after the target Supabase project and functions API are visible to the current owner-approved account.
operationalAccessPrerequisites.evidenceBoundary: This verifier checks only whether the current local CLI context can see required GitHub secret names and the target Supabase project/functions surface for live closeout. It records secret names only, never secret values, and does not deploy, mutate, ingest, rotate, or prove production behavior.
doesNotProve: live checkout, live MRR, partner commitments, documented outcomes, manual WCAG conformance, legal compliance, or production uptime
validity, freshness, or correctness of any secret value
operationalAccessPrerequisites.rawEvidencePolicy: Keep Supabase access tokens, service-role data, project-management credentials, logs with user identifiers, and deployment approvals outside git; commit only redacted status artifacts and command evidence.
operationalAccessPrerequisites.repoDoesNotDo: The repo cannot grant Supabase project access, run production deployment closeout, ingest live O*NET data, or prove parser deployment without owner-approved access and execution.
